title: Actually expensive for what you get
text: How come if these are official they don't come with official art? It would have been great to see some of the great MTG art made into tees that actually have the rights to put it into merch, but instead we get messy Photoshop-like images that are just a no. I liked the first and the Christmas designs, but the other 3 of them I got were pretty lame. I could have gotten something of both better quality and with nicer art for the same price somewhere else.
label: neutral
